text:
alex: quick note — onboarding Aster9b-int4. Short prompts look fine but long runs >1k tokens show repeating snippets and embedding drift.

sam: repro + convert flags?

alex: running on ded int4. convert-tool v2.3 with head_pack=interleaved, rotary=auto, tokenmap_pack=true. repro: `rdm-run --model aster9b/int4 --prompt long_exam.txt --max-tokens 1600`

eric: that combo rings alarm bells. interleaved head pack with auto rotary can misindex sin/cos per head. can you dump kv-key diffs vs fp16?

maya: also check tokenizer: when tokenmap_pack compresses, padding ids can be aliased; longctx + sentinel token could collide.

ci-bot: starting job aster9b-int4-smoke (runner: ded-gpu-4). link: https://ci.internal/runs/11223

sam: quick check: kv matches until ~700 tokens then pattern of phase flip every 128 tokens for some heads. looks like indexing expected contiguous per-head blocks.

eric: try rebuilding with `--head_pack separate --rotary explicit --preserve-tokenpad`. if that fixes we should add convert asserts.

ci-bot: rebuild finished. artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/11223/aster9b-int4-rebuild.tgz

sam: reran long run — stable to 2k tokens, embed cos sim delta ~0.02 vs fp16.

alex: nice. action items: 1) add convert-time assert verifying rotary table layout vs head packing 2) default to separate head packing unless runtime validated 3) include tokenmap packing map in artifacts and run sentinel/pad collision scan during convert 4) add 2k longctx smoke to int4 onboarding matrix.

eric: I'll add a small kernel CI test that checks rotary indexing for interleaved layouts.

maya: I'll file tokenizer ticket to emit packing maps.

sam: thanks — I'll run a sweep overnight across other models (Zephyr, Orion, Nebula) with new flags. reopen if we see new regressions. :thumbsup:
